xodexdesign.webflow.io.summary: Strict black-and-white studio language: one neo-grotesk sans, mostly in uppercase. White rounded cards and underline-only form fields sit on pure black. The only color is in the photos (an orange motion-blur editorial shot and gray-backdrop team headshots), and spacing is generous.
